requirements.text: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
4+ years building production front-ends at a venture-backed startup or top technology firm
Expert in TypeScript and React, with a deep understanding of rendering performance, state management, data fetching, and real-time patterns.
Comfortable across the stack — designing APIs, working with async services, and debugging the systems behind your UI
Strong product sense and design taste; comfortable working closely with designers and product managers.
Frequent user of AI products, especially during the development lifecycle (i.e. Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork abilities

This role requires deep expertise in modern web front-end engineering (TypeScript, React), strong product sense, and comfort working in the backend when needed. iOS experience is highly valued: we are bringing Max and more to mobile, and you would help build it. You will work directly with applied researchers and infrastructure engineers, so you should be comfortable understanding the full system, from model call to UI.
Experience building LLM- or agent-facing products
